extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent attorneys/agents, and patent applicants
extracted.subtask_description: Table of Contents for the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) Eighth Edition, Revision 6, listing chapters and appendices that contain USPTO examination procedures, substantive patentability standards, and administrative/policy guidance. Useful as an index pointing to the specific procedural and legal standards relevant to preparing, prosecuting, and examining U.S. patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blue Pages
rubrics_metrics.description: Blue Pages (administrative/front-matter chapter in the MPEP).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains front-matter administrative material and possibly summary information; see Blue Pages for overview and high-level program information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title Page / Foreword / Table of Contents / Introduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Front matter items (Title Page, Foreword, Table of Contents, Introduction) for the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides introduction, scope, and organization of the Manual; use to navigate to substantive chapters and understand revision history.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0100 - Secrecy, Access, National Security, and Foreign Filing
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 100: issues regarding secrecy orders, access to files, national security concerns, and foreign filing restrictions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains procedures and standards for handling national security/secrecy matters and foreign filing authorizations; consult for compliance when inventions implicate defense or foreign filing rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0200 - Types, Cross-Noting, and Status of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 200: classification of application types, cross-noting, and application status matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides rules and procedures for identifying application types and for noting cross-relationships/status; relevant for correct routing and processing of filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0300 - Ownership and Assignment
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 300: rules and procedures concerning ownership of patent rights and assignment recordation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses evidentiary and recordation practices for assignments and changes in ownership; consult for ensuring chain-of-title and correspondence records.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0400 - Representative of Inventor or Owner
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 400: standards for representatives (attorneys/agents) of inventors or owners before the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers recognition, duties, and conduct of practitioners and authorized representatives, including power of attorney and signature requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0500 - Receipt and Handling of Mail and Papers
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 500: procedures for receipt, acknowledgement, and handling of mail and papers submitted to the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains timely filing, receipt stamps, processing of correspondence, and related administrative handling rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0600 - Parts, Form, and Content of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 600: required parts, formal requirements, and content standards for patent applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details formal form and content requirements (specification, claims, drawings, oath/declaration), including statutory compliance and filing checklist items.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0700 - Examination of Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 700: substantive examination procedures and criteria used by examiners to evaluate patent applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains examiner guidance on substantive patentability analysis, office actions, rejections, allowances, and prosecution practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0800 - Restriction in Applications Filed Under 35 U.S.C. 111; Double Patenting
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 800: rules on restriction requirements and double patenting issues for applications filed under 35 U.S.C. 111.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides criteria and procedures for restriction practice, election of species, and handling double patenting rejections and terminal disclaimers.

rubrics_metrics.name: 0900 - Prior Art, Classification, and Search
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 900: guidance on prior art identification, classification systems, and searching techniques.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes principles for search strategies, application of prior art, and classification of technology; used by examiners and practitioners in prosecution and search.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1000 - Matters Decided by Various U.S. Patent and Trademark Office Officials
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 1000: decisions and procedural matters handled by different USPTO officials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers internal decision-making authorities, appeal routing, and administrative determinations within the USPTO structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1100 - Statutory Invention Registration (SIR) and Pre-Grant Publication (PG Pub)
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 1100: rules governing statutory invention registrations and pre-grant publication of applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains criteria and procedures for opting into SIR and rules for publication of applications before grant.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1200 - Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 1200: procedures for appeals from examiner decisions to the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) or other appellate bodies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains appeal briefing requirements, standards of review, and procedural timelines for appellate practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1300 - Allowance and Issue
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 1300: rules and procedures leading to allowance and issuance of patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details requirements for allowance, issue fees, publication of the patent grant, and post-allowance corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1400 - Correction of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 1400: procedures for correcting errors in issued patents (reissue, reexamination, certificates of correction, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains corrective mechanisms, eligibility, and requirements for obtaining patent corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1500 - Design Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 1500: rules specific to design patent applications and prosecution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers statutory requirements, claim/drawing standards, examination, and issuance procedures unique to design patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1600 - Plant Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 1600: provisions and practice for plant patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses botanical/plant-specific requirements, asexual reproduction proofs, and application content for plant patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1700 - Miscellaneous
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 1700: assorted topics not covered elsewhere in the Manual.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains various procedures and policies that are peripheral or cross-cutting across chapters; consult for niche topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1800 - Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 1800: guidance on international filing under the PCT and related national processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes procedures for entering the U.S. national phase, PCT search/examination interplay, and compliance with PCT formalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1900 - Protest
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 1900: rules and procedures governing protests against pending patent applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how protests are submitted, content standards, and how the USPTO handles third-party submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2000 - Duty of Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 2000: standards and obligations relating to the duty of disclosure, candor, and good faith (duty to disclose material information).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets out what constitutes material information, duty holders' obligations (applicants/attorneys/agents), and sanctions for failure to comply (inequitable conduct implications).

rubrics_metrics.name: 2100 - Patentability
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 2100: substantive patentability standards and statutory requirements (novelty, non-obviousness, statutory subject matter, enablement, written description, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Core chapter for applying patentability tests; includes legal standards, examiner guidance, examples, and case law references.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2200 - Citation of Prior Art and Ex Parte Reexamination of Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 2200: procedures for citation of prior art and for initiating ex parte reexamination proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes how prior art is cited in the prosecution record and the standards/processes for reexamination requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2300 - Interference Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 2300: rules governing interference proceedings (derivation/priority contests between applications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains initiation, conduct, and resolution of interference proceedings and priority determination standards (pre-AIA context).

rubrics_metrics.name: 2400 - Biotechnology
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 2400: guidance specific to biotechnology-related subject matter and special issues in that field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers patentability, written description, enablement, deposit requirements, and other biotech-specific examination considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2500 - Maintenance Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 2500: rules and procedures for payment of maintenance fees to keep patents in force.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes fee schedules, grace periods, surcharge procedures, and reinstatement policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2600 - Optional Inter Partes Reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 2600: procedures for optional inter partes reexamination of patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details filing, conduct, estoppel effects, and standards for inter partes reexamination.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2700 - Patent Terms and Extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP chapter 2700: rules on patent term adjustment and term extension (e.g., under Hatch-Waxman) and calculation of patent term.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how patent term is calculated, extensions/adjustments, and related filing requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix I - Partial List of Trademarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix I: a partial list of trademarks referenced in the Manual.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference appendix; consult for trademark examples when relevant to MPEP discussions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix II - List of Decisions Cited
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix II: compilation of decisions cited throughout the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful reference for locating cited case law and USPTO decisions supporting chapter guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix L - Patent Laws (Consolidated Laws)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix L: consolidated text of the patent statutes applicable at the time of this MPEP revision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary statutory reference; use when checking legal provisions cited in MPEP procedural and substantive guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix R - Patent Rules (Consolidated Rules)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix R: consolidated patent rules and procedural regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the regulatory text (37 C.F.R. and related rules) governing practice before the USPTO; authoritative for procedures and compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix T - Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix T: text/materials related to the PCT included in the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference materials for international filing under the PCT and national-phase practice in the U.S.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix AI - Administrative Instructions Under The PCT
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix AI: administrative instructions related to PCT practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supplementary PCT administrative guidance and instructions relevant to USPTO practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix P - Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix P: materials related to the Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference for priority and international filing rights under the Paris Convention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index - Subject Matter Index
rubrics_metrics.description: Index: subject-matter index for the MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the index to locate specific rules, topics, and guidance across the Manual quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability and Distribution Notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on obtaining copies of the MPEP (PDF/HTML/DVD-ROM/paper), revision history, and ordering/contact information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative guidance on acquiring and citing the Manual and who to contact for ordering or subscription matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revision History / Current Revision Notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Notice of which documents were updated in Revision 6 (e.g., Blue Pages; Title Page; Chapters 700, 1800, and 2100; Appendices II, L, R, T, and AI; and the Index).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies changed chapters and appendices in this revision; consult these sections for updated guidance and legal changes.
